approach: From Diablo, take the Stetattle Creek trail about 2 mi, drop about 200 ft to ford the creek opposite Davis Peak, then bushwhack and scramble a Class 3-4 rib, roping up for slabby sections, through slide alder above the cliffs to flat ground at the toe of the glacier, about 4,000 ft. Expect roughly eight or nine hours from the road. The Stetattle Creek trail is currently closed for post-fire hazards.

access.closures: As of late August 2026, the Stetattle Creek Trail is closed under a long-term post-fire hazard closure (falling dead trees and other ground hazards); check the current closure before a trip.
access.landManager: National Park Service — North Cascades National Park / Ross Lake National Recreation Area
